example.thai: สถานีต่อไปคืออโศก

words.note: Train automated announcements always begin with 'สถานีต่อไป' (The next station is...) followed by the station name in Thai and English.

example.thai: รถไฟขบวนนี้เข้าชานชาลาไหน
example.phonetic: rót-fai khà-buan níi khâo chaan-chaa-laa nǎi
example.english: Which platform does this train arrive at?

words.note: BTS and MRT platform signs show numbers (e.g., ชานชาลา 1 or 2) pointing toward the direction of travel.

words.thai: เปลี่ยนสาย

example.thai: เราต้องไปเปลี่ยนสายที่สยาม
example.phonetic: rao dtɔ̂ng bpai plìan-sǎai thîi sà-yǎam
example.english: We have to transfer lines at Siam.

words.note: Siam is Bangkok's most famous cross-platform transfer station between the BTS Sukhumvit and Silom lines.

example.thai: ห้างอยู่ใกล้ทางออกหนึ่ง
example.english: The shopping mall is near exit 1.

words.note: Always check station area maps for the specific exit number, as taking the wrong exit can leave you on the wrong side of busy multi-lane roads.

example.thai: รถไฟขบวนนี้มีปลายทางที่คูคต
example.phonetic: rót-fai khà-buan níi mii bplaai-thaang thîi khuukót
example.english: This train terminates at Khu Khot.

words.note: Bangkok trains display their final terminus station on front windshields and overhead signs to help you confirm you are boarding in the correct direction.
